title: 第25章 倒春寒第26章 神女柳晶晶
slug: 重生后长公主只想种田
content_zh:
;;
柳晶晶做梦了，梦见风光霁月的大皇子在归朝途中被人设计重伤昏迷，所带领士兵无一生还。
种种迹象表明，这一切与长公主有关。
“果然是朵黑心白莲花，表面上看着善良柔弱，事实上阴狠毒辣，为了上位不择手段。”
柳晶晶捏紧拳头，觉得不能继续拖下去，必须要做点什么了。
往旁边看了眼，差点没忍住一巴掌抽上去。
废物一个，怪不得在书里会是个悲情男配，明知道长公主是什么样的人，还不乐意和离。
她白起了那拯救他的心思，烂人，就该烂在泥里。
——
早晨起了雾，刚转暖的天又急转直下，院子里的植物上布满了白霜。
天空暗沉沉的，一点太阳都没有。
“这天不太好啊，你确定要出门？”沈青鱼抬头看了看天，火髓草的药效早就过了，如今也感觉到了冷意。
今日这天，怕是倒春寒。
“你明日不是要去封地？”云珏眉头轻蹙。
这样的天气确实不适合出门，可今日若是不去，何时才能有机会？
沈青鱼有些惊讶地看着他：“你竟然不反对跟我一起去？那可是很危险的。”
云珏沉默了片刻，道：“受伤前，镇魔司刚拟定了计划，清洗大青山。”
等清洗大青山后，他便会继任司主一职。
可计划赶不上变化。
谁也没料到寒山寺那里的寒潭会有一条寒冰蛟，若非它突破金丹时引来天象，恐怕至今都不会发现。

而且谁也没料到寒冰蛟修为竟如此高，那一战折了不少人进去，他自己也重伤变成如今这般。
“既然如此，走吧。”沈青鱼伸手摸了摸云珏的脸，又把手探进他身体摸了下。
云珏浑身僵直：“你……”
话还没说完，就见沈青鱼收回手说道：“本来还想着要不要给你披件厚点的，来个汤婆子的，结果你这身子比地上的霜还要冷上几分，那些都不管用。”
云珏：原来是这意思。
青天白日的，差点被她吓出心梗来。
若是云珏一人回来，云家这扇大门还真不一定会开，可来的是赤阳长公主。
虽然朝野上下都在观望，揣测宣和帝对长公主的态度，可未明了之前也不好做得太过。
“这出了名的娇弱公主，到我们府上做什么？”云尚书皱起眉头。
对云珏进了长公主府当面首一事，云尚书是知道的，但并不认为堂堂一国长公主会为了个废物面首上门讨教。
“妾身不知，不如去看看？”云夫人轻声细语劝说着。
她长相一般，看着却温婉动人。
对长公主开脉一事，他们也有所耳闻，但并不觉得开脉就能变强。
开脉后顶多就比普通人强上一些，到底还是个废物。
沈青鱼推着云珏轮椅，大摇大摆进门，没有去和云尚书打招呼的意思，而是直奔云珏曾经所住的地方去。
云珏伤重不过才三个月，院子基本还保留原来的模样。
他到底是大渊的有功之人，被宣和帝看重，哪怕沦落为废人，也下口谕一定要照顾妥当。
若过早将院子清理，让上头知道了，怕是免不了一顿责罚。
反正人也活不久，不如等人没了再说。

Liu Jingjing had a dream. She dreamed that the glorious eldest prince was seriously injured and fell into coma on his way back to the court. None of the soldiers he led survived.
There are various signs that this is all related to the eldest princess.
"As expected, she is a white lotus flower with a black heart. She looks kind and weak on the surface, but in fact she is vicious and vicious, and she will do whatever it takes to get the upper hand."
Liu Jingjing clenched her fists, feeling that she couldn't drag it out any longer and had to do something.
He glanced to the side and almost couldn't hold back a slap.
He is such a loser, no wonder he is a tragic male supporting character in the book. Even though he knows what kind of person the eldest princess is, he is still unwilling to divorce her.
She thought of saving him in vain. Dead people should rot in the mud.
——
It was foggy in the morning, and the warm weather suddenly turned cold again. The plants in the yard were covered with white frost.
The sky was dark and there was no sun at all.
"It's not a good day today. Are you sure you want to go out?" Shen Qingyu raised his head and looked at the sky. The effect of the fire marrow grass had long since expired, and now he felt cold.
Today is probably a cold spring day.
"Aren't you going to the fiefdom tomorrow?" Yun Jue frowned lightly.
This kind of weather is indeed not suitable for going out, but if we don’t go today, when will we have the chance?
Shen Qingyu looked at him in surprise: "You don't object to going with me? That's very dangerous."
Yun Jue was silent for a moment and said: "Before he was injured, the Demon Suppressing Division had just made a plan to clean Daqingshan."
After Daqingshan is cleansed, he will take over as the director.
But plans can't keep up with changes.
No one expected that there would be an ice dragon in the cold pool at Hanshan Temple. If it hadn't caused a celestial phenomenon when it broke through the golden elixir, I'm afraid it wouldn't have been discovered to this day.
And no one expected that the Ice Dragon's cultivation level would be so high. Many people were lost in that battle, and he himself was seriously injured and became like this.
"In that case, let's go." Shen Qingyu reached out and touched Yun Jue's face, then put her hand into his body and touched him.
Yun Jue stiffened: "You..."
Before he finished speaking, Shen Qingyu took back his hand and said, "I was originally thinking about wrapping you in something thicker, like a Tang Pozi one, but it turns out that your body is a bit colder than the frost on the ground, so that won't work."
Yun Jue: So that’s what it means.
It was so bright and clear that she almost gave her a heart attack.
If Yun Jue comes back alone, the door to the Yun family may not open, but it is Princess Chiyang who comes.
Although everyone in the government and the public were watching and speculating on Emperor Xuanhe's attitude towards the eldest princess, it was not advisable to go too far before it was clear.
"What is this notoriously delicate princess doing in our house?" Yun Shangshu frowned.
Yun Shangshu knew about Yun Jue's visit to the eldest princess's house, but he didn't think that a dignified eldest princess would come to her house for advice just because of a loser.
"I don't know who I am, why don't you go and take a look?" Mrs. Yun persuaded her in a soft voice.
She looks ordinary, but looks gentle and charming.
They had also heard about the eldest princess opening her pulse, but they didn't think that opening her pulse would make her stronger.
After opening the pulse, he would at most be a little stronger than ordinary people, but he would still be a waste in the end.
Shen Qingyu pushed Yun Jue's wheelchair and swaggered through the door without intending to say hello to Yun Shangshu, but went straight to the place where Yun Jue once lived.
It has only been three months since Yun Jue was seriously injured, and the yard has basically retained its original appearance.
After all, he was a meritorious person in Dayuan, and was valued by Emperor Xuanhe. Even if he was reduced to a useless person, he was ordered to take good care of him.
If you clean up the yard too early and let the superiors know about it, you may be punished.
People don’t live long anyway, so it’s better to wait until they are gone.
